requestedText: Replace prefix-only configured source URL validation with deterministic fail-closed URL and local-destination checks.

evidence: The validator parses supplied configuration strings and performs no runtime loading, reflection, plugin lookup, or dynamic dispatch.
The public CompanyConfig/CompanySourceRegistry API remains the existing repository-local runtime boundary; no external consumer migration is introduced.
The change adds no telemetry, monitoring, scheduler, webhook, or alert integration.
The Contract limits the change to deterministic URL validation and preserves the existing public registry and fixture contracts.
